PURPOSE HELD
OVER TIME.
fields.subheadline: An institution is not only what it has built. It is what it continues to protect, improve and pass forward.

fields.title: Three decades of excellence
fields.body: Founded in 2048 B.S. with a commitment to accessible, rigorous English-medium education. Its founding purpose still guides daily decisions: know the learner, respect the family, strengthen the community.

fields.mission: To provide quality education that nurtures intellectual curiosity, moral character, and social responsibility in every student.
fields.vision: To be a leading educational institution in Nepal, recognized for academic excellence, holistic development, and community impact.

fields.name: Dr. Maya Gurung
fields.message: Welcome to Everest English Boarding Secondary School. For over three decades, we have been committed to providing an education that goes beyond textbooks. Our goal is to nurture well-rounded individuals who are prepared not just for examinations, but for life. We believe in the power of curiosity, the importance of character, and the value of community. Every student who walks through our gates becomes part of the Everest family — a family that supports, challenges, and celebrates each other. I invite you to explore our school and discover the Everest difference.
